key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Master toggle for the whole global menu bar.

key.name: custom-menus
key.summary: JSON list of custom menu sections
key.description: Each entry: {label, enabled, items: [{label, kind: "command"|"shortcut", value}]}. Supports any number of independent custom top-level menus.

key.name: logo-icon-name
key.summary: System icon name for the System Menu button

key.name: logo-custom-icon-path
key.summary: Path to a custom icon file for the System Menu button
key.description: Highest priority: when non-empty, overrides everything else.

key.name: logo-distro-icon
key.summary: Bundled distro icon stem (e.g. "pear", "fedora", "arch"), empty for none

key.name: logo-distro-icon-symbolic
key.summary: Use the symbolic (single-color) variant of the bundled distro icon

key.name: logo-icon-size
key.summary: Icon size in pixels for the System Menu button

key.name: clock-on-the-right
key.summary: Move the clock to the far right of the panel
key.description: GNOME centres the clock; macOS keeps it in the corner with the status icons to its left.

key.name: hide-power-button
key.summary: Hide the Quick Settings power icon

key.name: hide-panel-spacers
key.description: Screen recording, screen sharing, dwell click, accessibility and keyboard layout indicators.

key.name: group-spotlight-with-quick-settings
key.summary: Keep the Search Light icon next to Quick Settings

key.name: gap-before-quick-settings
key.summary: Space to the left of the Quick Settings icons, in pixels
key.description: Separates them from whatever sits before them, such as a search icon.

key.name: gap-before-clock
key.summary: Space between the Quick Settings icons and the clock, in pixels

key.name: show-system-settings
key.summary: Show System Settings item in System Menu

key.name: show-app-grid
key.summary: Show App Grid item in System Menu

key.name: extensions-app-id
key.summary: Desktop file ID of the extensions manager app to launch

key.name: system-menu-custom-items
key.summary: JSON list of custom shell-command items added to the System Menu
key.description: Each entry: {label, value}. Appears as its own section at the bottom of the System Menu.

key.name: desktop-app-name
key.summary: Name shown for the file manager / desktop placeholder in the App menu
key.description: Used for File menu items such as "New X Window" while an app is focused. The App menu no longer uses this as a fallback when every window is minimized.

key.name: debug-logging
key.summary: Enable verbose error logging to the system journal
key.description: Off by default to avoid excessive logging; turn on temporarily when diagnosing an issue.
